lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb8In4Ag4Br24 (reduced formula Rb2InAgBr6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 40 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ag and In centers, each coordinated by six Br neighbors, while Rb centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 Br neighbors. The Ag- and In-centered octahedra share corners, and face-sharing is observed between Rb polyhedra and the Ag or In octahedra; the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
